status.source: This site's box scores and Player cards; the remaining fixture from the NBL's own API (prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au)
method: Team strength = point margin per game adjusted for opponent and home court, with shooting luck taken out

Shooting luck = 3s and free throws made minus expected: every shooter's estimated true 3P% / FT% (this season plus his past seasons on the Player cards), the defence's small effect on 3P% allowed and the team's own shot-quality effect
Ratings pulled toward average by how few games each team has played
The 101 remaining games played out 100,000 times; projected record = average wins, rounded so the ladder adds up
Ladder ties: wins, then wins between the tied teams, then points difference in those games, then overall
Availability: each game to come adjusts both teams for who is out or back compared with the games their strength is built on (availability.py, calibrated on 1,458 NBL games 2015-26)
